prerequisites: The student has already followed courses from the first semester in phase 1.

learning_outcomes.text: The student is able to formulate a clear problem statement, objective, and assignment for electronic or ICT systems in consultation with stakeholders.
He/she substantiates the assignment through analysis and research.
The student is able to develop an electronic or ICT system for a proof of concept or service based on a program of requirements.
He/she is able to realize a relevant implementation of the established requirements. He/she justifies the choices made for the different components.
The student delivers a working proof of concept solution or service.
The solution is a complete and correct implementation of established requirements. He/she verifies and validates the product or service against the stated requirements.
He/she documents the realization process.
The student makes a technological system function in its application context or work environment.
He/she establishes a management system with a view to reproducing it and ensuring its continued functioning.
The student communicates purposefully about the assignment using the main current communication forms and techniques.
He/she is able to clearly summarize the different aspects of his project, articulate them orally and in writing, and present them visually.
The student can offer relevant advice to third parties in relation to his/her design and the associated process.
This for a wide variety of stakeholders and possible target groups.
The student understands his/her own entrepreneurial ability.
He/she demonstrates an entrepreneurial attitude including initiative, out-of-the-box thinking, perseverance, design thinking, critical thinking, self-knowledge, and action orientation.
The student understands the principles of translating new concepts, products, or services into value creation and new business models from a market-oriented vision.
He/she considers commercial feasibility.
The student strives for quality work in project and performance management. He/she performs his/her own tasks as independently as possible and works solution-oriented.
He/she manages, evaluates, and optimizes his/her own effectiveness. He/she adjusts based on feedback.
He/she approaches assignments in a project-based manner, respects planning and budgetary context, and adjusts if necessary.
He/she functions in a team-oriented and entrepreneurial manner.
The student adopts a constructive attitude as an expert member of a (project) team with a view to his/her own (future) role and responsibility within a company or organization.
He/she thinks in an international and digital work environment.

syllabus_topics: Project-dependent, multidisciplinary content aligned with various course components of the program
Deliverables and final presentation for the project

assessment_methods.method: Practice Enterprise (lab): reports, final presentation and realization

assessment_rules: The assessment is based on the communicated Practice Enterprise 1 Assessment Framework. Partial transfers are possible for successful partial results (YT5971 - Practice Enterprise ICT - basic: theory and YT5991 - Practice Enterprise ICT - basic: Lab) within the academic year. For the resit, a new project cannot be submitted.
